documents.title: RAG overview
documents.body: Retrieval augmented generation combines search over a knowledge base with large language model answers. Hybrid retrieval blends dense vectors and sparse BM25 keyword scoring.

documents.title: Fixed chunking
documents.body: Fixed size chunking splits documents into equal token windows with overlap. It is simple to implement and predictable for embedding batch jobs.

documents.title: Recursive chunking
documents.body: Recursive chunking respects paragraph and sentence boundaries before applying size limits. It reduces mid-sentence cuts compared to blind fixed windows.

documents.title: Semantic heuristic chunking
documents.body: Semantic chunking uses embedding similarity drops between sentences as split signals. The heuristic approximates topic shifts without running a full segmentation model.

documents.title: Hybrid search
documents.body: Hybrid search merges dense nearest neighbors with BM25 lexical ranks via reciprocal rank fusion. It improves recall when queries mix proper nouns and paraphrases.

documents.title: Dense retrieval
documents.body: Dense only retrieval embeds chunks and queries into the same vector space. It excels on semantic similarity but may miss rare entity tokens.

documents.title: Tenant A retention policy
documents.body: Tenant A requires ninety day log retention for customer support tickets. Metadata filters must scope search to tenant_a and category policy.

documents.title: Tenant B retention policy
documents.body: Tenant B mandates encrypted backups and thirty day PII purge for EU users. Queries for tenant_b must never return tenant_a chunks.

documents.title: Metadata filters
documents.body: Metadata filters narrow candidates by language category or ACL fields before ranking. They prevent cross-tenant leakage when paired with partition indexes.
